verdict.rationale: Fireflies.ai is a SaaS meeting-intelligence service, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents a GraphQL API, an Apollo Sandbox, code examples and an official MCP server, but nothing shows a first-party command-line tool. The API and MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
